question: Bohag Bihu is also known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rangali Bihu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rangali Bihu** is another name for **Bohag Bihu**, which marks the **beginning of the Assamese New Year**.
 
• It is one of the most important festivals in Assam and is celebrated with great enthusiasm and joy.
 
• Bohag Bihu falls in **mid-April** and is also known as the **Spring Festival**.
 
• It is a time for feasting, dancing, and singing, and it signifies the time of harvest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bohag Bihu is the first of the three Bihu festivals in Assam; the other two are **Kongali Bihu (Kati Bihu)** and **Magh Bihu (Bhogali Bihu)**.
 
• Each Bihu festival is associated with different agricultural activities and seasons.
 
• During Bohag Bihu, people wear traditional attire, prepare special dishes, and participate in cultural programs.
 
• Bihu dance and Bihu songs are integral parts of the celebration, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of Assam.
